name: Nemo Stats: Weapons MG
description:
Tunes the machine guns' spread, damage, and magazine reloads.

MG-43, M-1000 and MG-206 get lower drag and much higher durable damage, rebalanced per weapon: MG-43 and M-1000
around the DMR, MG-206 around the magnum caliber. M-105 and MG-43 get swapped scopes (4x and 10x).

- weapons:
  - M-105 Stalwart
    Balanced around Liberator damage.
    Scope swapped to 4x.
  - MG-43 Machine Gun
    Balanced around DMR damage.
    Scope swapped to 10x.
  - M-1000 Maxigun
    Balanced around MG-43, same damage, but with backpack.
  - MG-206 Heavy Machine Gun
    Balanced around magnum caliber.
    Has better AP (penetrates even on light angles), but lower damage than DMR with lapua.
  - E/MG-101 HMG Emplacement / weapon
    Reduced recoil.
- stratagems:
  - E/MG-101 HMG Emplacement
    Balanced around magnum caliber, full-auto at 1200 RPM.
    Larger ammo pool and a tougher hull than stock.
